## Purpose

Describe the defect or maintenance boundary addressed by this change.

## Impact

List affected roles, APIs, database tables, middleware, and compatibility concerns.

## Verification

List backend, frontend, browser, and infrastructure checks actually executed. Add screenshots for UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the frozen maintenance scope described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests or a documented reason why automated coverage is not practical.
- [ ] Database, API, and documentation changes are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, proxy configuration, or machine-specific absolute paths are included.
